text: This chapter extends the 3-part 4ths Close & Spread material into C Melodic Minor across all 6 cycles. Notation-heavy: paired Intervallic and Functional Voice-Leading grids govern each voicing type, including Drop 3 (4 → c.t., 3 → c.t., 7 → 2nd, 1 → 2nd) and Drop 2 & 4 (7 → 3, 3 → 7, 4 → 1, 1 → 4 functional). Cycle 7 introduces third-motion in voice 4 marking the characteristic interval signature of septimal root motion. The C Melodic Minor pivot in Cycle 2 (4-way close) shows the altered scale degree's effect on intervallic motion, establishing both grids simultaneously.
